name: mountain-dew-group
description: Mountain Dew Group - hotel booking platform, mobile apps and staff portal

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm -r --filter './apps/api' build && pnpm -r --filter './apps/web' build
scripts.vercel-build:api: pnpm -w run build:packages && pnpm --filter @mdg/api exec prisma generate
scripts.vercel-build:web: pnpm -w run build:packages && pnpm --filter @mdg/web exec next build
